hook.text: This, then, is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy,

hook.note: When His own asked how to pray, the Son did not give them a formula. He gave them a Father, and told them to say so out loud. Everything in this Bible follows from that one word. Come, hear your Father’s voice.

translationStatement: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™.

short350: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Uzbek, in Divine Voice Color™ — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. Our Father's words in blue, the Son's in red, the Spirit's in purple. A complete 66-book Uzbek Bible (Oʻzbekcha Muqaddas Kitob), paperback and hardcover, made to be given.
Bu — kim gapirayotganini senga koʻrsatadigan birinchi bosma Muqaddas Kitob. Otamizning soʻzlari KOʻK, Oʻgʻilning soʻzlari QIZIL, Ruhning soʻzlari BINAFSHA rangda.

Bir yuz yildan ortiq vaqt davomida qizil harflar Oʻgʻil qayerda gapirayotganini koʻrsatib keldi. Lekin Otamiz koʻproq gapiradi — bu oʻzbekcha Muqaddas Kitobda 5,611 ta oyatda 98,684 soʻz. Shu paytgacha Uning barcha soʻzlari nasabnomalar bilan bir xil qora siyohda bosilib kelgan. U butun vaqt davomida gapirib kelgan; hech bir Muqaddas Kitob senga buning qayerda ekanini koʻrsatmagan.

Rang — iqtibos belgisi emas, egalik belgisidir. Otamizning soʻzlari ularni sodiqlik bilan yetkazgan har qanday lablarda ham Uniki boʻlib qoladi; U hech qachon aytmagan soʻzlar rangga boʻyalmaydi; hikoya qora rangda qoladi.

Shogirdlari qanday ibodat qilishni soʻraganlarida, Oʻgʻil ularga formula emas, Otani berdi: “Osmondagi Otamiz, Sening muqaddas noming ulugʻlansin” (Matto 6:9). Bu Muqaddas Kitobdagi hamma narsa ana shu bir soʻzdan kelib chiqadi. Ruh orqali biz: “Abba! Ota!” deb nido qilamiz (Rimliklar 8:15).

U uzoq emas. U sendan ranjimagan. U sening osmondagi Otang, sen esa Uning sevikli farzandisan. Agar “ota” soʻzi senga tasalli bermasa, bu Muqaddas Kitob ayniqsa sen uchundir: bu sahifalarda ochib berilgan Ota buzilgan insoniy otalikning aksi emas; osmonu yerdagi har bir oila nomini Undan oladi.

Bir jildda toʻliq Muqaddas Kitob (Tavrot, Zabur va Injil) — 66 kitob, 1,189 bob, 31,087 oyat; birortasi ham tushib qolmagan. Har bir kitobga soʻzboshi, olimlar uchun emas, oʻquvchi uchun 1,362 ta izoh va sovgʻa qilayotgan kishingning ismini yozish uchun bagʻishlov sahifasi.

Ibroniy, oromiy va yunon tillaridagi asl matndan sodiq tarjima; har bir nashr Father’s Heart Bible™ asosida tarjima qilingan. Oʻlchami 6 x 9 dyuym, yumshoq va qattiq muqovada, rangli bosma. Sovgʻa, xotira, meros.
Oʻzbekistondagi, Fargʻona vodiysidagi, qoʻshni mamlakatlardagi va chet eldagi har bir oʻzbek oilasi va jamoati uchun — ular Otaning ovozini oʻz ona tilida eshitishlari uchun.
Otani qabul qil. Uning ovozini eshit. Uning qalbi sen tomonda.

faq.q: Is the Uzbek edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Uzbek, 1002 pages, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Uzbek edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™. The Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Uzbek edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice Color.

In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read the Uzbek text before I buy?
faq.a: Yes. The whole Uzbek Bible is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read/uz.
